brief: Members: Cenomi Centers told Tadawul that a court on 21 Oct dismissed the Mall of Dhahran owner's claims, which ANB Capital totals at SAR 788.3 million; the owner can appeal within 30 days, and Cenomi handed the mall back in April 2026 when its lease ended.

AI shopping: Walmart opened its systems to third-party AI shopping agents through an Agent Gateway, with Agent Profiles that let shoppers set limits and approve purchases, the opposite of Amazon's and eBay's blocks.

Service: the Federal Tax Authority and Planet cut the UAE's tourist VAT refund wait to one business day, from about nine, with an AI platform that uses facial recognition at the Abu Dhabi, Dubai and Sharjah airports (21 Oct).

2027 Directory: Friday's check of 15 listings found five changes, including Seef Mall's redevelopment, Doha Festival City's 244,000 sqm GLA, Al Khail Avenue's obsolete 2019 date and likely duplicates for Sobha and Wasat Al Madinah; Mall of Dhahran is not on Brilliant and goes to sheet 10 as Check first.
Quiet day: two verified items were dated 22 Oct, and Q3 results and Q3 market reports have not started yet, apart from ValuStrat's Dubai Q3 2026 review.
weekly_brief: Week 43 (19 to 23 October): 35 findings and 16 library documents across five editions, and the second Friday check of 15 directory listings.

Saudi calendar: after the 10 Oct attack, the Saudi Retail Forum moved to March 2027, FII10 was postponed to 2027 and Intersec Saudi Arabia moved to October 2027; King Khalid International reopened on 17 Oct, but several airlines have suspended Saudi flights into November and beyond, a point to plan around for RCM Jeddah on 7 to 8 Dec.

Pipeline: Arada launched Arada KSA with a SAR50bn land bank and a SAR14bn Riyadh master plan, Talaat Moustafa Group agreed four mixed-use mega-projects with the Egyptian state worth about EGP 11 trillion, Awqaf Dubai is building an AED73m endowment shopping centre in Hind City, and Arada's own figures put Madar Mall at Aljada at 1.1m sq ft GLA for December 2028.

Openings and tenants: Primark opened its first Qatar store at Doha Festival City on 21 Oct, eight days early; Malabar opened its 13th Qatar showroom at Safari Mall; Majid Al Futtaim marked 25 years of City Centre Muscat and five of Mall of Oman; One Retail will bring Primor to Morocco in 2027; and Dubai Shopping Festival runs from 4 Dec to 17 Jan.

Members: Majid Al Futtaim's Precision Media launched Precision Insights to link ads to sales, Aldar and ADIB launched Darna cards worth up to 10% back at Aldar malls, and Cenomi won dismissal of the Mall of Dhahran owner's claims, subject to appeal.

AI shopping agents split the market: Amazon and eBay block them, while American Express published a framework for agent purchases, Salesforce agreed to buy Braze for about $5.66bn and Walmart opened an Agent Gateway; in the UAE, Emirates NBD will run OpenAI models in-country, Abu Dhabi set up TAMM Global and tourist VAT refunds now take one business day.
Türkiye: Torunlar GYO set Forum Kayseri AVM's final price at EUR 131,904,579, and WinsTown AVM in Diyarbakır handed its leasing to MSP.

2027 Directory: the week sent Forum Kayseri AVM (Add now), Madar Mall (Add to pipeline) and the Hind City centre (Check first) to sheet 10, and Friday's check found five listing changes and seven 2022-era pipeline listings that could not be confirmed from owners' sources.

findings.title: Cenomi Centers wins dismissal of the Mall of Dhahran owner's claims, subject to appeal
findings.summary:
Cenomi Centers told Tadawul that a ruling issued on 21 Oct 2026 dismissed the lawsuit brought by the owner of Mall of Dhahran, which it was notified of in March. The owner had sought SAR 161.853 million in fair rental value for mall and expansion areas not covered by a contract, SAR 103.397 million in rent for the part of the mall damaged by fire and SAR 523.028 million in revenues from the property; ANB Capital put the total at SAR 788.3 million in June.

The owner may appeal within 30 days of the date set for receiving the judgment, after which it becomes final, and no financial impact was stated. ANB Capital also reported that Cenomi completed a phased handover of the mall in April 2026, when its lease term expired.
findings.why: If the ruling stands it removes SAR 788.3 million of claims against a member, and the handover leaves one of the Eastern Province's best-known malls outside Cenomi's portfolio and without a directory entry.

findings.entity: Walmart Agent Gateway and Agent Profiles
findings.title: Walmart opens its systems to third-party AI shopping agents, with limits set by the shopper
findings.summary:
Walmart announced on 21 Oct a Walmart Agent Gateway that lets AI assistants such as OpenAI's ChatGPT, Google's Gemini and Meta's Muse connect directly to Walmart and Sam's Club systems to search for products and complete purchases. Agent Profiles, rolling out next month, let shoppers authorise individual agents, see each agent's purchases separately, set a spending limit or approve every transaction, and revoke access at any time.

Agents cannot access payment card data and can be blocked for breaking company rules, and the tools are open to all account holders without a Walmart+ membership.
findings.why: Walmart's opt-in rules for agent identity, permissions and spending limits are the counter-model to the Amazon and eBay blocks reported on 19 Oct, and a template GCC retailers and mall apps can benchmark before agent traffic reaches the region.

findings.company: Federal Tax Authority, with Planet (authorised operator)
findings.title: UAE cuts the tourist VAT refund wait from about nine days to one business day with an AI platform
findings.summary: The Federal Tax Authority and Planet, the authorised operator of the UAE's VAT refund scheme for tourists, have launched an AI-powered digital platform that cuts the total wait for a refund to one business day, from about nine days. WAM says verification uses AI-powered facial recognition, with data entry through Planet's mobile app, in a fully digital and paperless process at Zayed International, Dubai International and Sharjah International airports. No platform name, start date or retailer figures were published.
findings.why: The refund is the last step of a tourist's mall shopping journey, so a one-day refund matters to retailers ahead of Dubai Shopping Festival (4 Dec 2026 to 17 Jan 2027) and is a ready case study in AI-enabled service for MECSC.

findings.title: Sobha Community Retail Centre appears to duplicate the Sobha Hartland mall due in H2 2026

Sobha Realty's own release (July 2024; the page shows no year) announces an AED 210 million mall in Sobha Hartland with a gross leasable area of around 115,000 square feet, a built-up area of approximately 339,000 square feet, 35 retail shops and F&B outlets plus more than 10 dining options, and completion scheduled for the second half of 2026. No other Sobha retail centre was found.

The directory entry prints 18,580 sqm GLA and the developer as 'Shobha Realty' (last updated April 2024), and the tracker already carries 'Sobha Hartland Community Mall (Sobha Mall)'.
findings.why: Printing both entries would count one Sobha scheme twice, with a size the developer does not publish.

Confirm with Sobha Realty that no separate community retail centre exists and whether H2 2026 still holds.

findings.title: Al Khail Avenue: the printed 2019 opening is obsolete, and Skylight Mall may be its new name
findings.summary:
Dubai Holding's release launching the Dubai Retail brand (4 Sep 2025) lists Al Khail Avenue among malls 'planned for opening in the near term' and says its development will add 1.2 million square feet to Dubai Retail's GLA, with no opening date; the brand groups the former Nakheel malls under Dubai Holding Asset Management. On 6 Oct 2026 Dubai Retail announced Skylight Mall, a super-regional mall along Al Khail Road with 1.3 million sq ft of GLA, more than 360 stores and a 2027 opening, without saying whether it is the same project.

The directory still prints Al Khail Avenue as an upcoming Nakheel mall opening in 2019 Q1.
findings.why: The entry prints a 2019 opening for a mall that has not opened, under an owner name no longer used, and printing Skylight Mall separately could duplicate one scheme.

directory.directory_says: Upcoming, 2019 Q1, Nakheel PJSC / Nakheel Malls, GLA 139,500 sqm
directory.change: Remove 2019 Q1 and show 'in development, date to be confirmed'; replace Nakheel with Dubai Retail (Dubai Holding Asset Management); the GLA Dubai Holding published in Sep 2025 is 1.2 million sq ft. Ask Dubai Retail whether Skylight Mall (1.3 million sq ft GLA, 2027) is the renamed Al Khail Avenue: if yes, rename the entry and use the Skylight figures so there is no second entry; if not, add Skylight Mall separately.

findings.title: Wasat Al Madinah: the 2023 Q4 opening has passed and the entry probably duplicates Multaqa AlMadinah
findings.summary: The directory prints Wasat Al Madinah as an upcoming regional centre of 70,000 sqm GLA by Knowledge Economic City, opening in 2023 Q4. KEC's release of 9 Aug 2026 (on Zawya) presents Multaqa AlMadinah Mall as the retail heart of a mixed-use destination with a 390-key Hilton hotel and 66 Hilton-branded residences, with no opening date, and KEC gives Multaqa 72,000 sqm of retail GLA (checked 16 Oct). No Tier A source uses the name Wasat Al Madinah ('downtown Madinah'), so the match rests on owner, city and size.
findings.why: A member's mall may be printed twice, once with a 2023 opening that did not happen.

directory.directory_says: Upcoming regional centre, 70,000 sqm GLA, Knowledge Economic City, 2023 Q4
directory.change: Ask KEC to confirm that Wasat Al Madinah is an earlier name of Multaqa AlMadinah; if so, remove this entry and keep Multaqa AlMadinah (72,000 sqm retail GLA, not open, date to be confirmed). If it is a separate scheme, replace the 2023 Q4 opening with KEC's current status. It should not print as upcoming with a 2023 Q4 opening either way.
